captions.detailed: This 3D-printable model is a custom mounting clip designed to hold a cylindrical object, such as a flashlight, and attach to a brim or slot. It consists of a large C-shaped clamp with flared insertion tabs at the opening for easy snap-on mounting. Attached to the back of the C-clamp is a rectangular block containing a slot for a hard hat brim, complete with two hexagonal nut traps and corresponding screw holes on the outer face for secure fastening.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hard hat flashlight clip in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to adjust the overall clip width, flashlight diameter, wall thickness, and mounting screw/nut sizes, resulting in a single-piece snap-on clamp with an integrated mounting block.
captions.factory: The model is built by extruding a 2D profile and subtracting mounting holes. The 2D profile is created using a union of a circular ring (representing the flashlight clamp) and a rectangular block (the clamp base with a slot) created via square and circle primitives. Flared insertion tabs are formed by unioning a large polygon and trimming it with a difference of circles. This combined 2D shape is extruded using linear_extrude to the specified clip_width. Finally, hexagonal nut traps and screw holes are subtracted from the extruded body using rotated cylinders with 6-sided and high-resolution circles.
